verify:full.gate: every T0 + T1 + T2 task passes

verify:selftest.gate: every registered gate returns non-zero with one planted defect

ci:local.gate: HEAD, checked out into a temporary worktree and installed from the lockfile alone, passes every tier

audit:secrets.gate: 0 findings across every tracked and untracked-not-ignored file

typecheck.gate: 0 type errors across all 4 tsc projects

audit:integrity.gate: 0 unledgered markers, 0 non-ledgerable markers, 0 expired or stale ledger entries

audit:ratchet.gate: no regression in the cheap fields: suppressions, scan fingerprints, registered task list

audit:ratchet:full.gate: no regression in any measured field, including coverage denominators and the measured file set

build.gate: shared, server and client build with exit 0

test:unit.gate: all pass; shared and client coverage thresholds hold

test:integration.gate: all pass against a real mongod; server coverage thresholds hold

test:security.gate: the route table matches the real router stack, and every id-taking route refuses a non-owner without touching the target

test:observability.gate: no request value, audit row or production error body carries a secret, and a 5xx body is redacted to its status text

test:property.gate: every property holds in BOTH timezones: the crypto round-trip and its fresh IV, the five schemas as fixed points, combineExpiry across a fall-back DST repeated hour, the entropy metrics monotonic, deliveryNotes unrendered, and the folder forest acyclic and within the nesting cap under any sequence of operations

test:snapshot.gate: the Bitwarden JSON, Bitwarden CSV and Chrome/Edge CSV exports match their committed goldens byte for byte, every golden carries a provenance note naming its verifier, date and source, and import(export(items)) yields the same logical items

test:a11y.gate: every primary view and modal — fifteen of them, in the real authenticated DOM — carries zero serious or critical axe violations, and the focus behaviours a scanner cannot infer still hold: the saved-address combobox keeps DOM focus on its input while aria-activedescendant tracks the active option, Escape closes that panel without closing the dialog around it, focus is re-homed across every billing-section transition, and the create dialog's focus trap holds

test:fuzz.gate: no import file and no backup document — arbitrary bytes, the committed corpus, or a generated hostile document — crashes a parser, exceeds its wall-clock budget, produces an item its own schema rejects, or loses a well-formed row to a swallowed duplicate key

test:resource.gate: every operation over a vault at MAX_ITEMS_PER_USER stays inside its committed time and memory budget: the backup collector refuses an oversized vault with 413 after mongod has delivered a fraction of it, the largest permitted backup still collects in full, a 10,000-item key rotation completes and one naming an unknown id changes nothing, a ~25 MiB backup whose escaped body exceeds 26 MB restores through the route's 30 MB parser, and both cross-user cleanup sweeps seek rather than scan

test:upgrade.gate: a vault and a .env written by the previous release are still readable by this one: every stored item opens under the crypto this release ships, decrypts to the bytes 0.7.0 sealed and parses to exactly what 0.7.0 parsed it to, no item schema declares a required field, a folder without sourceRefId and a refresh row without absoluteExpiresAt are accepted and the latter still slides by seven days, the settings that release lacked are filled in without a migration, that release's .env loads the current server's environment configuration in production, every variable since removed is ignored rather than fatal, and every required one that is absent or blank refuses the boot by name and fast

test:recovery.gate: this application survives the two disasters it is built for: a backup downloaded from one database restores into an empty account on a SECOND mongod with every item decrypting to the bytes that were sealed and each one still paired with its own name, the downloaded document survives the round trip its signature is computed over (so a signed backup still verifies, and an altered one does not), a backup is worthless without its backup password, and a real process killed mid-write always leaves the stored vault key OLD with its write fence still up — a login clearing that fence only once the dead rotation's lock has genuinely expired, the interrupted rotation completing on retry, and no crash before, inside or after the import write leaving a partial insert behind

test:mutation.gate: the oracle: Stryker mutates every production file in the declared scope — packages/*/src/** minus the coverage-excluded entry points and the presentational UI primitives — and the suite kills at least the recorded share of them, with the six core modules held to their own recorded scores, no file dropping out of the measured set, and no mutant left untested that was tested before

test:smoke.gate: the BUILT artifact boots in production mode against a real mongod, serves a deep-linked SPA route with a matching CSP nonce, and completes a register → sign-in → store → read-back journey whose ciphertext round-trips byte for byte

test:deploy.gate: the Compose stack comes up from nothing with every service healthy and both one-shots completed, publishes exactly one loopback-bound port and nothing else, completes a vault journey through that port, keeps the data across a restart, and re-runs its bootstrap without rewriting a rotated application password

coverage:check.gate: every package holds the line, branch and function coverage recorded in baseline.json, every production line this change touched is covered — with a dated COV-DIFF-EXEMPT ledger entry the only way to excuse one — and no changed production file sits outside the measured scope, where its patch coverage would read as 100% over nothing

audit:bundle.gate: the built client's initial payload and every emitted chunk stay inside their committed size budgets, so a library this application loads on demand — zxcvbn, Argon2id, the file-encryption tool — cannot become a static import without the build going red

audit:deps.gate: 0 production advisories at moderate or above

audit:secrets:full.gate: 0 findings across the working tree AND every blob in git history

deadcode.gate: 0 unused files, exports, types or dependencies; duplication at or below the committed ceiling

audit:config.gate: 0 error-level findings from actionlint, hadolint and spectral

audit:licenses.gate: every production dependency carries an allowlisted licence; 0 copyleft

audit:image.gate: all 4 images build; nginx -t passes; compose config resolves; 0 fixable HIGH/CRITICAL

deferred.test:api: No separable command exists today. Every supertest suite lives beside the unit suites in packages/server/tests/*.test.ts, so the only ways to register it would be a committed test filter (a non-ledgerable TEST-FILTER under the integrity doctrine) or a second, duplicate invocation of the 125-second server suite that would report false independence. test:integration runs those suites today. Register test:api once the API suites move under their own directory.
